hook: A root-inspired microneedle adhesive joined tiny blood vessels in rats 78% faster than suturing.
hook_turn: joined tiny blood vessels in rats 78% faster than suturing.

readout.label: Shorter procedure time in rat models

summary: The adhesive pairs a water-repelling polymer with tetrahedral microneedles that interlock with vessel walls, and carries a wireless sensor with AI to track blood flow and graft health. In rats it cut procedure time and reduced thickening of the vessel lining. Results are from rat models only.
title: AI-monitored bioadhesive for sutureless microvascular anastomosis.
